explanation: Controller with force_limit 20 saturates at +20 while short heavy pole (0.3m, 0.5kg, gravity 15) with coarse dt 0.02 and initial offset theta=0.2, v=0.5 plus off-grid push t=0.011 len 0.19 force 10 cannot prevent fall: theta goes -0.750 at step14 to -0.779 at step15 to -0.8029 at step16 exceeding 0.8 rad pole_upright limit. Saturated control indicates under-actuated/fast-unstable regime.
vision_note: The pole leans to the left and tips progressively farther over from steps 13 to 15 while the cart remains near the center. At step 16 the pole tip turns red, indicating the pole has exceeded the upright limit.
